# Index: decisions files

> Read when: you need the right decisions reference and the routing table in SKILL.md did not name it.
<!-- generated by scripts/build-index.py; do not edit -->

- [Companion routing after an MCP audit or sketch](decisions/companion-routing.md) - an MCP audit finding or architecture sketch is done and you must decide which implementation, test, or non-MCP route takes over. Companions are option...
- [Designing a new MCP server](decisions/design-phase.md) - you are about to write tool code for a new MCP server and must decide how to consolidate endpoints, shape schemas, and write descriptions
- [Choosing an error-handling strategy](decisions/error-strategy.md) - you decide how an MCP tool reports failures, guards destructive calls, caps retries, or stops an agent retry loop
- [MCP vs CLI: should this be an MCP server?](decisions/mcp-vs-cli-evidence.md) - you audit or design an MCP server and the real question may be whether the workflow belongs in MCP at all, before you touch schemas or descriptions
- [MCP and CLI hybrids, kill criteria, keep criteria](decisions/mcp-vs-cli-hybrids.md) - you have decided MCP may be the wrong abstraction, or you keep MCP and need hybrid patterns, red flags, keep signals, and the order in which to optimize
- [Production deployment checklist for an MCP server](decisions/production-readiness.md) - you move an MCP server from development to production and must settle transport, observability, health checks, deployment, rate limiting, and caching
- [Choosing a tool response format](decisions/response-format.md) - you decide how an MCP tool serializes its result (TSV, YAML, JSON, text, structured content), how it paginates, and who sees which part
- [Scaling an MCP server architecture](decisions/scaling.md) - one MCP server may no longer be enough and you must choose between a gateway, session pooling, background tasks, or multi-agent coordination
- [Securing an MCP server](decisions/security-posture.md) - you choose the security model for an MCP server (local vs remote, scopes, SSRF, untrusted content, PII, multi-server hijacking)
- [Steering contract: guiding the agent through tool output without opening an injection channel](decisions/steering-contract.md) - a tool response or error will tell the agent what to do next, or you are auditing whether tool output is trusted too much or steers too little
- [Surface Choice: CLI, MCP, Skill or Hybrid](decisions/surface-choice.md) - you must decide whether an agent workflow should stay CLI-first, move to an MCP server, be covered by a skill, or split across surfaces
- [Handling a growing tool count](decisions/tool-count.md) - an MCP server exposes, or will expose, more than about 10 tools and you must choose between pruning, grouping, meta-tools, and semantic search
